title: Looping Deeper Without Growing the KV Cache: Recurrent Depth for Causal Encoder-Decoders
abstract: arXiv:2611.13378v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Looped language models deepen computation without adding parameters, yet caching full-context key-value (KV) states across layers and rounds severely bounds serving batch size. We design a looped causal encoder-decoder (CED) that achieves recurrent depth with zero round-wise KV growth, addressing where and how to loop an asymmetric stack in which only sparse encoder layers generate global KV. We find that recurrence must be placed in the encoder to iteratively refine global KV representations rather than re-reading static decoder projections, which both drives language-modeling gains and preserves long-context scaling. Furthermore, training the encoder loop under stochastic recurrence depth induces a fixed-point equilibrium where every round losslessly shares the last round's KV cache. translated_title: 无需增大KV缓存的更深循环：面向因果编码器-解码器的循环深度
translated_abstract: 循环语言模型能够在不增加参数的情况下加深计算，然而在层与轮次之间缓存全上下文的键值（KV）状态严重限制了推理服务的批次大小。我们设计了一种循环因果编码器-解码器（CED），实现了零轮次KV增长的循环深度，并解决了在非对称架构堆栈中何处以及如何进行循环的问题——该堆栈中仅有稀疏的编码器层生成全局KV。我们发现，循环必须放在编码器中，以迭代式地精炼全局KV表示，而不是重新读取静态的解码器投影，这既能带来语言建模性能的提升，又能保持长上下文的扩展能力。此外，在随机循环深度下训练编码器循环会诱导出一个不动点平衡状态，使得每一轮都能无损地共享上一轮的KV缓存。通过叠加跨层与跨轮的KV共享，最终的Looped CED达到了未循环CED的最小内存占用，并恢复了86-93%的性能……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种循环因果编码器-解码器架构，通过将循环置于编码器以迭代精炼全局KV表示，并利用随机循环深度训练诱导不动点平衡实现跨层与跨轮KV缓存无损共享，从而在不增大KV缓存的前提下获得循环深度带来的性能提升。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a looped causal encoder-decoder that places recurrence in the encoder to iteratively refine global KV representations and trains with stochastic recurrence depth to induce a fixed-point equilibrium, enabling lossless cross-layer and cross-round KV cache sharing and thus achieving recurrent depth gains without growing the KV cache.
